name: Steel Wind Strike

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: up to five creatures you can see within range

summary: Flash between up to five creatures: a melee spell attack against each, 6d10 Force on a hit.
text: Afterwards you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.
